summary: The production Flight decoder preserves hosted writer stamp and check intent, big-endian group lengths, the exact world fingerprint at the action cursor and the held row's revision metadata.

drop_writer_stamp.defect: Decode the installation comparison as a check for absence.

reorder_group_length.defect: Swap the two bytes of the relation length or group count.

reorder_world_fingerprint.defect: Decode the world fingerprint in reverse byte order.

expect.category: invariant not satisfied at end of loop body

drop_held_revision.defect: Write a zero revision into held point metadata in place of the row's stamp.
